title: Export every downstream-needed formula as an explicit port
obstacle: A downstream step must mine a producer proof or source equation for a missing conclusion.
procedure: Inspect the exact downstream-consumed formula and all its binders/conditions.
If absent from the port, stop the translation and repair/version NL0 plus its affected Audit A.
Regenerate packets and interfaces; never silently import source notation or an ancestor claim.
verification: The downstream packet alone states every reused fact; source labels are locators only.
positive_example: The historical case-2 N055 output omitted a formula later needed by R058.
negative_example: Having the formula in an earlier proof body does not make it a declared input conclusion.
version_boundary: Pattern observed in these pinned sources; exact APIs must be checked at application.

evidence.excerpt:
